name: target-audit
description: Use for the recurring adapter truth check, or when a tool ships a new config feature

findings.excerpt: `curl -sD - <url> | head -c 400` shows the status, the headers, and the first bytes together. It is the fastest way to tell a real page from a stub.
Re-check every negative with `curl -sL` before reporting it. A fetch that contradicts a prior audit is more often a fetch failure than a vendor change.
- quirk: `r.jina.ai` refuses anonymous requests from low-reputation networks (401, target-audit 2026-09-26). Plain `curl -sL https://cursor.com/docs/<page>.md`
- quirk: the old `/docs/cli/custom-agents/configuration-reference/` path is an HTTP 200 meta-refresh stub, not a 3xx. Inspect with `curl -D -` before calling a
- trap: `tools` is not a Claude pass-through. The closed table rejects unknown IDs, so `Bash`/`Write`/`WebFetch` translate to `Execute`/`Create`/`FetchUrl`. `To
